verdict.rationale: Kimi's API platform could plausibly offer a test or sandbox mode, so the axis applies, but the pack documents none. The API reference's "Try it" runner calls the production endpoint with a real API key. The console Kimi Playground is a model-experimentation tool, not an isolated environment separate from production data. Local agent command execution in Kimi Code is also not documented as sandboxed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
